_note: Candidate registry for Hawaii 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (State of Hawaii Office of Elections, 2026 Candidate Report with candidate status (page says last updated September 4, 2026), CSV export, linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: State of Hawaii Office of Elections, 2026 Candidate Report with candidate status (page says last updated September 4, 2026), CSV export (https://olvr.hawaii.gov/Controls/CandidateFiling.aspx?elid=94); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
